title: DiamondFire
description: Create your own minigames! DiamondFire has over 70,000 playable games made by community members.
body:
Create your own minigames

With DiamondFire, you can create custom Minecraft minigames using an in-game block-based coding system. Bring your ideas to life within minutes; no setup or prior programming experience required!

## A Minecraft network like no other... DiamondFire has over 70,000 playable games made by community members. Check out some of our top picks below:
Features game-specific diamondfire.games addresses. ## Games made in hours, not days. Creating games is just a matter of placing blocks. ## A thriving community Connect with DiamondFire players and staff on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/pDHBbBD).
